_note: LFM2.5-24B-A2B MLX 6-bit (affine, group 64 = 6.5 bits/weight = 0.8125 B/param) on M1 Max 32GB, 32-core GPU. From config.json: 40 layers (30 short-conv, 10 full attention, 32 heads x 64, 8 KV heads), hidden 2048; 2 dense FFN layers (11776) and 38 MoE layers (64 experts x 1536, top-4); tied 128000 x 2048 embedding. Params: experts 22.95B, other non-embedding 0.75B, embedding/head 0.26B (total 23.97B; 19.5 GB on disk matches 0.8125 B/param). Active per token: 1.44B experts + 0.75B + 0.26B head = 2.45B. KV f16: 10 x 8 x 64 x 2 x 2 B = 20480 B/token. Bandwidth and peak are the MLX measurements from the Inkling run on this same machine. No drafter: every small LFM2.5 MLX model has a 65536-token vocabulary, the 24B one 128000.
